facts.fact: The document describes the Pointe-Noire Tier 3+ data centre as the ARPCE's own, the Agency for the Regulation of Posts and Electronic Communications, a state regulator, put into service on 2024-02-28.

note: Pointe-Noire owner fact recorded; document says it 'will be able to host' public administration data, which is capacity not hosting, so no state fact; Brazzaville ownership not stated beyond housing in ARPCE building.
